findings.text: follow-on: the artifacts line names snapshot_candidates_warm_ms (base median 307.5 ms, head 161.2 ms) and cites measure_candidates.py and driver_run_attempt head-warm.log, but no log in the run directory records either arm's snapshot.candidates timing -- head-warm.log/head-warm.json are the census driver's output, which fell back on a budget_snapshot OSError and produced no snapshot.candidates stage, and the direct measurement script's stdout was not saved; the caveat at manifest.md:19 discloses this, so the figure is disclosed-unbacked rather than false, and it should be re-run under a writable scratch RECKON_HOME.

follow-on: requirement 2 asks to recount only a file whose stamp has changed, but context_census rebuilds the whole census when any stamp moves -- build() re-reads the entire standing chain and node file set -- so the per-file granularity is not delivered; the reused figures are still equal to an uncached census, and tests/test_pick_candidates_one_pass.py:167 pins the whole-rebuild behaviour (builder calls 1 then 2 after one touched file).

follow-on: requirement 1 named run_time_profile.local_lane_load as the reader of each lane document, but that function takes no path argument and reads only the fixed local-lane document, so it cannot serve an arbitrary backend's lane_document; the landed routing.pick_lane_document is a second reader of the same published documents (a third counting snapshot's removed inline json.loads), and the deviation is reported at manifest.md:19.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 2a813c755; b37ba0cde is the change (one-pass scan, pick-scoped lane-document cache, stamped census) and 586043f2b is a one-line trailing-newline fix in the new test file.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure has four parts; the gate asserts parts 1-3 (equality, one-pass scan count, census reuse) and the declared negative control reddens test_candidates_iterates_the_records_once, but part 4's latency figures are unbacked in the record (see the manifest finding).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a production pick scan the ledger once and reuse its instruction census; snapshot.candidates:510-521 replaces the per-backend recent_outcomes/_peak_input_utilisation loops with one _candidates_scan pass (snapshot.py:158) and routes the estimate through routing.context_census (snapshot.py:96) so a pick scans the rows once and reuses the census, and test_one_pass_scan_matches_per_backend_reference confirms every candidate field is unchanged.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261007T165000435924-pick-candidates-one-pass/manifest.md; it records both commits, the four changed paths, both gate arms (base 2 failed/704 passed/1 error, head 1 failed/709 passed/1 error, zero added ids), the negative control, and discloses at line 19 that requirement 4's census driver could not run under the fence.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the four changed paths -- docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/pick-candidates-one-pass.html, reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_pick_candidates_one_pass.py -- all lie inside the declared fence; the declared docs/figures path was not used, correctly, because the done-when names the fragment and no figure.

justifications.durability: the four added tests fail if the change regresses -- test_candidates_iterates_the_records_once reddens (6==1) when the per-backend scan is restored (negative-control.log), the equality test compares candidates against the retained reference readers, and the two census tests count builder calls (1 then 2 after a touched stamp).
justifications.evidence: the gate asserts the equality (tests/test_pick_candidates_one_pass.py:137), one-pass scan count (:159) and census reuse (:167) and its negative control reddens the scan-count test, but the done-when's requirement-4 latency measure is recorded only as an unbacked manifest figure -- no log in the run directory holds either arm's snapshot.candidates timing, and the cited head-warm.log is the census driver's failed fallback.
justifications.fit: the added names -- _candidates_scan, _peak_summary, _outcome_counts, pick_lane_document, context_census, _census_request_key -- describe mechanism with no plan, sprint or version identifier and follow the module idiom at reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:113.
justifications.goal_fidelity: snapshot.candidates:510-521 computes outcome counts and peak values in one _candidates_scan pass and routes the node estimate through routing.context_census, so the pick reads the ledger once and reuses its census; the objective is met, with requirement 2's per-file granularity coarser than the measure's wording.
justifications.reuse: routing.context_census:3467 extends the existing owner capabilities.cached_pick_input_stamped/file_stamp rather than adding a cache, but pick_lane_document (reckon/crew/routing.py:3356) is a new file reader for a document lane_document.read_lane_document and run_time_profile.local_lane_load already read.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path is inside the declared fence, but requirement 1's named mechanism run_time_profile.local_lane_load is replaced by a new reader routing.pick_lane_document, a deviation the plan section's exact spec called a blocker to report; it is reported at manifest.md:19.
